meta.name: Misthi Maheshwari
meta.subtitle: Building deep ML systems and full-stack products. Transitioning fluidly between computer vision, LLM agents, and robust web backends. Grounded in real deployed systems.

about: I'm a B.Tech Computer Science (AI/ML) student at SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Chennai, currently at a 10 CGPA. Most of what I know, I picked up by shipping production systems end to end — a real-time warehouse dispatch platform at Aditya Birla Group, and a legal contract analyser at Infosys — with results ranging from 80-90% accuracy on real-world data.

points: Engineered a full-stack warehouse dispatch system (React.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL) that evaluates stock across three warehouses and recommends the optimal one for order fulfilment.

Solved over-allocation during simultaneous VIP and normal orders by enforcing per-warehouse dispatch caps with priority-weighted logic, and calculating expected wait times from restock dates for out-of-stock items.
Implemented REST APIs with secure authentication and an admin dashboard displaying live inventory, dispatch limits, today's dispatched quantities, and pending/VIP order queues.
Built an AI-powered chatbot for customer order queries and automated PDF reports summarising each order's status, quantity, and assigned warehouse.
Developed a document-processing tool extracting data from Excel, Word, PDF, text, and image files, achieving ~80% accuracy on real company data.
Built end-to-end ML pipelines (Python, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn) covering model selection, training, hyperparameter tuning, and evaluation.
Used Pandas/NumPy preprocessing to handle missing values, outliers, and feature engineering.
Delivered reproducible AI applications on Colab/Jupyter, using Matplotlib-driven EDA.

Built Clause AI, a web platform where users register, log in, and upload legal or business contracts for automated analysis — extracting key clauses, obligations, risks, and non-standard terms in seconds.
Engineered the backend in Python using LangGraph and LangChain, with a PyPDF2/python-docx pipeline and Pinecone for semantic clause search — cutting review time by ~80%.
Delivered results in JSON and PDF formats with a history section, through a Streamlit interface.
